findings.evidence: Line 3: docstring says 'Admin orders router — canonical.' Line 18: prefix='/api/v1/admin/orders'. Lines 21-72: all routes are /campaigns, /metrics, /campaigns/{cc}, /campaigns/{cc}/{id}, /admin_orders_routes/health. No order management endpoints (list, get, update status, delete, bulk-status) exist.
findings.notes: Router is mislabeled and contains comms domain routes instead of order management routes. Imports from domains.comms.ports (lines 11-16).

findings.evidence: Line 75: @router.get('/admin_orders_routes/health') — path is not under the router prefix root. Full path becomes /api/v1/admin/orders/admin_orders_routes/health.
findings.notes: Health endpoint path is double-nested and inconsistent with other admin routers.

findings.evidence: Line 23: require_feature('orders.list') on /campaigns route. Line 30: require_feature('orders.read') on /metrics. Line 45: require_feature('orders.list') on /campaigns/{cc}. Line 57: require_feature('orders.create') on POST /campaigns/{cc}. Line 69: require_feature('orders.manage') on DELETE /campaigns/{cc}/{id}.
findings.notes: Campaign/email metrics routes are gated with orders.* feature atoms instead of promotions.campaigns.* atoms.

findings.evidence: Lines 58-59: get_cart endpoint has _rf_gate: None = Depends(require_feature('customers.cart.manage')). Feature gate is present.
findings.notes: The endpoint already has the required feature gate per Law 88. Finding documents correct behavior but was recorded as NEW.

findings.evidence: Line 124: price: float in CartTotalsItem. Line 142: subtotal = sum(item.price * item.quantity for item in body.items) — float arithmetic for money.
findings.benchmark_mismatch: Law 19: Monetary values MUST use Decimal or Numeric. Float FORBIDDEN for money.
findings.notes: Float math in cart totals violates Law 19. Although later code converts to Decimal (line 149), the initial subtotal calculation uses float.

findings.evidence: Line 175: tax_result = calculate_tax(float(after_discount), country_code, db) — float explicitly passed to tax calculation.
findings.benchmark_mismatch: Law 19: Monetary values MUST use Decimal or Numeric. Float FORBIDDEN for money.
findings.notes: Explicit float() cast on Decimal value before passing to calculate_tax violates Law 19.

findings.evidence: Lines 72-79: sync_cart endpoint accepts CartSyncRequest and calls svc_sync_cart(current_user.id, body, db). No idempotency key parameter or validation visible in router.
findings.benchmark_mismatch: Law 50: Explicit transactions required for all writes. Idempotency not evident.
findings.notes: Idempotency is not visible at the router layer; depends on service implementation.

findings.evidence: Lines 148-153: try/except block around build_coupon_quote with bare except Exception that silently sets discount = Decimal('0').
findings.benchmark_mismatch: Law 59: No silent exceptions. Law 68: Consistent errors.
findings.notes: Bare except swallows validation errors and returns zero discount silently, violating Laws 59 and 68.
